diagnostics.description: Fixed font size may not support Dynamic Type
diagnostics.rationale: A fixed system font size can make text harder to read when the user requests larger accessibility sizes.
diagnostics.suggestion: Prefer a semantic text style such as .body or scale custom typography with UIFontMetrics.
diagnostics.title: Fixed font size

diagnostics.description: Button with image-only or empty content should provide an accessibility label
diagnostics.rationale: An unlabeled control can prevent VoiceOver users from understanding its purpose.
diagnostics.suggestion: Add an accessibilityLabel that describes the action, or use a control initializer with a meaningful visible title.
diagnostics.title: Missing accessibility label

diagnostics.description: Image should be labeled or explicitly hidden from accessibility
diagnostics.rationale: An image needs a clear semantic intent so assistive technologies either describe it or ignore it as decoration.
diagnostics.suggestion: Provide a meaningful accessibilityLabel, use accessibilityRepresentation, or mark a decorative image with accessibilityHidden(true).
diagnostics.title: Image accessibility treatment
